steps.note: the API built this case's state
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one product for the vendor's unit-price submission.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before publishing.
Invite a QA vendor to the RFQ.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can submit a bid.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the live RFQ pricing sheet as the vendor.
Enter and submit the specified huge numerical unit price.
Confirm the vendor portal accepted the quote.
Verify the submitted bid price is displayed without truncation or overflow.
